summary: SCN-duchess-house-front: the plan is oblique, so the layout.json chimney_stack landmark (0.45, 0.13) marks the chimney's projected top, not its base.

findings.issue: Oblique camera (known env-concept defect). The chimney base is modelled at y 0.234 at the north-west corner of a 3.64 x 5.73 m footprint derived by removing the height shift. Staging that targets the chimney_stack landmark on the ground will land about 1.6 m north of the house.

options: A: accept; staging uses the landmark only as a look-at target (height 9 m)
B: redraw a true plan view and recalibrate layout.json
